# Pragnya Works

> Pragnya Works is an independent software company founded in 2026 by Shubhojeet Bera. It builds and operates AI products, including Edward, and works with founders and teams on production-grade software.

## Company

- Company: Pragnya Works
- Founder: [Shubhojeet Bera](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubhobera)
- Founded: 2026
- Website: https://www.pragnyaa.in
- GitHub: https://github.com/pragnya-works
- Contact: shubhojeet@pragnyaa.in

## Products

- [Edward](https://edwardd.app): An AI software development platform built and operated by Pragnya Works. Edward turns natural-language requirements into runnable web applications through planning, code generation and editing, sandboxed execution, debugging, live previews, and GitHub sync. Public launch in January 2026.
- [Edward source code](https://github.com/pragnya-works/Edward): The Edward repository on GitHub.
- [Edward demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zIBuOmr92_s): Video walkthrough of Edward building an app.

Edward supports Claude through Anthropic's API alongside OpenAI and Gemini. Users connect a provider with their own API key.

Pragnya Works also works with founders and teams on AI product development, web applications (Next.js, React, TypeScript), system architecture, and technical strategy.
